headline: Recommended approval of zone change for NS Fernbank Road from Residence B and Business A to Residence C, 6-0.
summary: A public hearing was held on Zone Change # 3266 for NS Fernbank Road. The petitioner is Onyx Springfield Crossing, LLC. One person spoke in favor and no one spoke against.
decisions: Recommended approval of Zone Change # 3266 for NS Fernbank Road, changing the zoning from Residence B and Business A to Residence C, by a vote of 6-0.
